verdict.rationale: CRA's e-services page lists "track the progress of files submitted to the CRA" as an online capability, and EFILE filers can view their transmission history. Both features sit behind sign-in, in a CRA account or with an EFILE number and password, rather than on openly accessible public pages, and each is backed by only a single brief mention. Missing for 10: a public (unauthenticated) status lookup for filings, applications, or cases; detailed documentation of what statuses are shown and for which file types; independent or hands-on corroboration.
